changelog:
- YouTube Zero-Stall ad blocking: 200 OK empty response for ad endpoints prevents black-screen pauses; auto-removes top 'Open App' button.
- Spotify Web Player desktop mode: bypasses 30-second mobile preview limit for full web streaming.
- Instant Search Engine Switch: changing search engines now immediately reloads the active search query on the selected engine.
- Integrated Fokk AI Reality Inspector: ambient verification for claims on X (Twitter), Reddit, and web articles.
